title: Muscles of the sole of the foot: deep layers (plantar)
attribution: 3D anatomy from Z-Anatomy, built on BodyParts3D (CC BY-SA). Rendered in Blender; surface detail added with an image model.

rows: Medial and lateral margins of the plantar surface of the calcaneus, by two heads.
Lateral margin of the tendon of flexor digitorum longus.
Straightens the oblique pull of flexor digitorum longus and helps it flex the lateral four toes.
Tendons of flexor digitorum longus in the sole.
Medial sides of the extensor expansions of the lateral four toes.
First (most medial): medial plantar nerve. Lateral three: lateral plantar nerve.
Flex the metatarsophalangeal joints and extend the interphalangeal joints of the lateral four toes.

structures.name: Flexor hallucis brevis muscle
objects: Medial head of flexor hallucis brevis.r
Lateral head of flexor hallucis brevis.r

rows: Plantar surfaces of the cuboid and lateral cuneiform.
Both sides of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe, by two tendons that each contain a sesamoid bone.
Flexes the great toe at the metatarsophalangeal joint.

structures.name: Oblique head of adductor hallucis muscle
prompts: Oblique head of adductor hallucis muscle

rows: Bases of metatarsals 2 to 4 and the sheath of the tendon of fibularis longus.
Lateral side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe, with the transverse head.
Deep branch of the lateral plantar nerve (S2, S3).
Adducts the great toe toward the second toe and helps flex it at the metatarsophalangeal joint.

structures.name: Transverse head of adductor hallucis muscle
prompts: Transverse head of adductor hallucis muscle

rows: Plantar ligaments of the metatarsophalangeal joints of toes 3 to 5.
Lateral side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the great toe, with the oblique head.
Deep branch of the lateral plantar nerve (S2, S3).
Adducts the great toe and draws the heads of the metatarsals together, supporting the transverse arch of the foot.

structures.name: Flexor digiti minimi brevis muscle of the foot
prompts: Flexor digiti minimi brevis muscle of the foot

rows: Lateral side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the little toe.
Superficial branch of the lateral plantar nerve (S2, S3).
Flexes the little toe at the metatarsophalangeal joint.
Three muscles, from the medial sides of metatarsals 3 to 5.
Medial sides of the bases of the proximal phalanges of toes 3 to 5.
Adduct toes 3 to 5 toward the second toe and flex their metatarsophalangeal joints.

structures.name: Dorsal interossei muscles of the foot
prompts: Dorsal interossei muscles of the foot

rows: Four muscles, each from the facing sides of two neighboring metatarsals.
First: medial side of the proximal phalanx of the second toe. Second to fourth: lateral sides of the proximal phalanges of toes 2 to 4.
Abduct toes 2 to 4 away from the line of the second toe and flex their metatarsophalangeal joints.
hy: DAB and PAD as in the hand, but the axis of the foot is the second toe: Dorsal interossei ABduct, Plantar interossei ADduct.
